user.title: Add an endpoint
user.description: Paste the address of a JSON API. A key in the address is recognised and stored safely. One test request is sent.

auth.title: This API needs a key
auth.description: Enter the token or key from your account with this service.

insecure.title: Unencrypted connection
insecure.description: This address uses plain HTTP, so your key can be read on the way. Continue only if you accept that.

reconfigure.title: Change the endpoint
reconfigure.description: Leave the key empty to keep the stored one.

found.title: What was found
found.description: Tick what you want. You can add more later. {note}

data.polling: How often to ask for new data
data.budget_limit: Monthly request limit, if your API has one

error.invalid_url: Enter a full http or https URL.
error.credentials_in_url: Do not put credentials in the URL. Choose an authentication type.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach this address. Check it, and that the service works.
error.invalid_auth: The service refused this key. Check that it is correct and active.
error.rate_limited: The endpoint reports too many requests. Try again later.
error.server_error: The endpoint reports a server error.
error.bad_status: The service refused this address. Check that it is complete.
error.bad_redirect: The endpoint redirects to another address, which is not followed, to protect credentials.
error.too_large: The response is larger than the size limit.
error.not_json: This address returned a web page or other text, not JSON data. Check the address.
error.name_required: Enter the name of the header or parameter.

data.budget_limit: Requests per period (0 for no budget)
data.reserve_percent: Reserve for manual requests, in percent
data.retention_seconds: Keep values for this many seconds (0 for no limit)

budget_exhausted.message: The request budget is used up until {time}.

rate_limited.message: The endpoint asked to wait until {time}.

broken_mapping.title: Mapping {mapping} cannot be read
broken_mapping.description: The path {path} failed in the last responses ({reason}). Change or remove the mapping.

collection_list_missing.title: List of {mapping} is missing
collection_list_missing.description: No list was found at {path} in the last responses.

collection_limit.title: {mapping} reached its item limit
collection_limit.description: The limit is {limit}, and {ignored} items are ignored. Raise the limit in the mapping.

collection_unreadable.title: Most items of {mapping} cannot be read
collection_unreadable.description: {count} items have no usable key at {path}, or no valid value.

unknown_kind.title: Mapping {mapping} is not available
unknown_kind.description: Its entity type is not supported here, so it is skipped. It stays stored.

rate_limited.title: {endpoint} keeps limiting requests
rate_limited.description: Set a longer interval or a request budget in the options.
